With Deadly Print Studio your minis come to life with battle effects and more https://deadlyprintstudio.com . We love how Deadly Print helps us achieve a better cinematic experience on the tabletop.

A Genestealer uprising on a docked imperial starship, sees it crash into the city. The Genestealers  commanded by Jordan rush to secure the precious cargo. Aiden and his Scions move swiftly to take it back. Who will emerge victorious in this epic struggle? Lists below.
